description: This file contains utility functions related to inventory management in vtiger CRM, including product detail retrieval, stock updates, notifications, tax calculations, currency conversions, and inventory history management.

methods.name: getProductDetailsBlockInfo
methods.description: Returns an array of details about products associated with a given module, focus object, and number of products.

methods.name: updateStk
methods.description: Updates the stock quantity for a specific product after an order.

methods.name: sendPrdStckMail
methods.description: Sends notification email when product stock falls below reorder level.

methods.name: getPrdQtyInStck
methods.description: Retrieves current stock quantity for a specified product.

methods.name: getPrdReOrderLevel
methods.description: Retrieves reorder level for a specified product.

methods.name: getTaxId
methods.description: Gets tax ID for a given tax type.

methods.name: getTaxPercentage
methods.description: Fetches tax percentage for a specified tax type.

methods.name: getProductTaxPercentage
methods.description: Retrieves tax percentage for a product based on tax type.

methods.name: deleteInventoryProductDetails
methods.description: Deletes inventory product details for an entity, optionally returning old values.

methods.name: updateInventoryProductRel
methods.description: Updates inventory product relationships and stock quantities after order processing.

methods.name: saveInventoryProductDetails
methods.description: Saves product details for inventory-related entities like Purchase Orders, Sales Orders, Quotes, and Invoices.

methods.name: getInventoryTaxType
methods.description: Retrieves tax type (individual or group) for a specific inventory entity.

methods.name: getInventoryCurrencyInfo
methods.description: Retrieves currency information associated with an inventory entity.

methods.name: getInventoryProductTaxValue
methods.description: Fetches applied tax value for a product in an inventory context.

methods.name: getInventorySHTaxPercent
methods.description: Retrieves shipping & handling tax percentage for an inventory entity.

methods.name: getAllCurrencies
methods.description: Returns list of all active currencies.

methods.name: getPriceDetailsForProduct
methods.description: Provides price information for products in a specified currency.

methods.name: getPriceBookCurrency
methods.description: Retrieves the currency used in a specific price book.
